# minimax-mcp
> Local-first stdio MCP server & Agent Skill for MiniMax Code desktop app on macOS via CDP & SQLite.

Local-first Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enabling Claude Desktop, Cursor, and AI agents to monitor and automate MiniMax Code on macOS with 27 tools and zero system accessibility permissions.

## Documentation
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/minimax-mcp/main/README.md): Overview, architecture diagrams, fast CDP control, and client configuration examples.
- [Agent Skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/minimax-mcp/main/skills/minimax-mcp/SKILL.md): Agent-native skill instructions and workflow decision boundaries.
- [Tech Stack Research](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/minimax-mcp/main/docs/MCP_TECH_STACK_RESEARCH.md): Architecture evaluation of Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), SQLite state-reading, and MCP protocol standards.
- [Full Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/minimax-mcp/main/llms-full.txt): Complete concatenated reference documentation including tool contracts and examples.

## Optional
- [Glama Registry Manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/minimax-mcp/main/glama.json): Server metadata and tool declarations for Glama.ai MCP registry.
- [Smithery Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/minimax-mcp/main/smithery.yaml): Registry configuration for Smithery.ai CLI and 1-click installation.
- [Doctor Diagnostic](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/minimax-mcp/main/scripts/doctor.js): 9-point runtime self-diagnostic script.
